definition: An essential eukaryotic RNA polymerase that transcribes critical non-coding RNAs, a transcriptional process regulated by transcription factors TFIIIB and TFIIIC (a complex in which GTF3C3 is a key subunit); impaired RNA polymerase III-mediated transcription is linked to neurodevelopmental disorders.

source.title: Biallelic variants in GTF3C3 encoding a subunit of the TFIIIC2 complex are associated with neurodevelopmental phenotypes in humans and zebrafish
source.quote: RNA polymerase III transcribes essential non-coding RNAs, a process regulated by transcription factors TFIIIB and TFIIIC.
